action.description: list reads what stands in this room; grant makes a grant and revoke takes one back, each on the owner's message of this turn and read back from the record.

relation.description: What is granted or taken back, for grant and revoke: a relation of the room (ask, search, notes, memories, reminders, file_todo, approve, launch, watch, room_rules, deploy, worker_talk, console), system for asking you about your own system, or rule for a standing rule in the owner's words, held by one person alone and opening every other relation for them.

sender.description: The holder, by the sender id the room's record shows; name either this or members.

members.description: true where the holder is every member of this room; name either this or sender.

words.description: For grant: the owner's words and the scope he gave, as he said them; a rule needs them.

until.description: For grant: when it lapses, as an RFC 3339 time; none where it stands until taken back.

message.description: The number of the owner's message in this turn that the grant is made on; where none is named, the turn's one message, or its newest where every message of the turn is the owner's.
